subject: Renewal request — Termbow Labs: capacity uplift, price anchoring & onboarding credit
messages:
From: Olivia Harris <olivia@termbow.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal request — Termbow Labs: capacity uplift, price anchoring & onboarding credit

Hi Priyom / Monica,

Hope youre both well. Termbow has a renewal coming up (current term ends 2027-08-15) and were planning a meaningful expansion: engineering expects sustained 2.5x token consumption over the next 12 months as we ship the new summarization flows.

Before we lock dates with Procurement, wanted to get a proposal from Redwood that addresses two priorities for us:

- Short-term price stability: wed like a 6-month anchor at our current blended rate while we ramp usage (helps our finance team forecast).
- Migration/onboarding support: a one-time credit to offset integration and eval effort (looking for ~$75k).
- Committed baseline: we can commit to a 12-month reserved baseline if we get a competitive committed discount on the committed portion (target ~20% off list for committed volume).

Can you send an updated term sheet and a clear breakdown of committed vs. surge pricing by Friday 6/25? Procurement will need a procurement/RFI to attach. Im looping Marco (Ops) on billing details.

Thanks — Olivia
Olivia Harris
Head of Platform Engineering, Termbow Labs
olivia@termbow.com
(415) 555-0192

Attachment: Termbow_Renewal_Request.pdf (summary of anticipated volumes and procurement timelines)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Harris <olivia@termbow.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal request — Termbow Labs: capacity uplift, price anchoring & onboarding credit

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear ask and the timing. Appreciate looping Marco.

High level proposal (draft) — Ive attached a marked term sheet (redwood_term_sheet_v2.pdf) for your Procurement:

1) Term & commit
   - 12-month agreement starting on signing.
   - Committed baseline: 3.6 billion tokens/month (aligned with the 2.5x growth you described) as the committed volume.

2) Price anchoring and ramp guard (novel: surge allowance concept)
   - Price anchor at current blended rate for the first 4 months to give Termbow runway to stabilize traffic.
   - Surge allowance: during months 5-8, committed price applies to baseline; volumes above baseline billed at an elevated surge rate but with a partial credit mechanism (we credit back up to 30% of surge spend as a seasonal buffer applied to month N+1 invoice, capped per quarter). This reduces volatility while preserving predictable unit economics for Redwood.

3) Credits & onboarding
   - One-time onboarding credit: $60,000 applied on first invoice (we can front-load part of this to cover initial infra/support).
   - Milestone credit: $15,000 credit unlocked after successful migration of the first production pipeline (to align incentives).

4) Committed discount
   - 18% discount on committed baseline compared to listed pay-as-you-go rate.

Next steps:
- Ill route this to Ben to get a final pricing approval and Legal for a short addendum.
- If this looks directionally right, Monica and I will prepare a procurement bundle (term sheet + procurement RFI) for submission by Friday.

Attachment: redwood_term_sheet_v2.pdf (draft with figures)

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
priym.das@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Renewal request — Termbow Labs: capacity uplift, price anchoring & onboarding credit

Priyom — thanks for the quick draft. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Anchor length: 4 months is helpful, but Finance is asking whether we can extend that to 6 months; that gives us time to de-risk the new pipelines.
- Onboarding credit: $60k is helpful; can we get to $75k total (either larger upfront credit or combination of onboarding + implementation support credit)?
- Surge allowance: the credit-back mechanism is interesting. Can you show a worked example (quarterly cap and example invoice) in the procurement bundle so Procurement can understand cashflow impact?

Ill attach our procurement packet (Termbow_Procurement_RFI.pdf) — Procurement needs the numbered sheet and a line item list of discounts/credits to embed in their purchase order.

If you can get a revised sheet with a worked example by EOD Thursday, thatd keep us on track for Friday submission.

Thanks — Olivia

Attachment: Termbow_Procurement_RFI.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 18:43:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal request — Termbow Labs: capacity uplift, price anchoring & onboarding credit

Team — Ive reviewed Priyoms draft and Olivias asks. Approve the following flexible concession structure to move the deal forward (terms to be captured in a concise addendum; Legal to draft):

- Anchor extension: 6-month anchor at current blended rate (approve).
- Onboarding credit: Approve $60k upfront + $15k milestone credit (total $75k in value) — record as two line items so Procurement sees both.
- Committed discount: Approve 18% on the committed baseline.
- Surge allowance worked example: Marissa/Prioyom, please add a one-page worked example showing the quarterly cap and how the credit-back is applied (use the figures in Priyoms term sheet).

Operational asks:
- Marissa, please coordinate with Legal to prepare the addendum and with Finance to confirm effective invoice flow for the credit-back.
- Priyom: generate a DocuSign-ready addendum and procurement bundle (term sheet + worked example + line-item discount table) and get it to Olivia by EOD Thursday.

Attachment: approved_concession_summary.xlsx (internal summary for ops)
